SIKA® VISCOCRETE®-20 HE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sika_viscocrete_-20he.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE is a third generation superplasticiser designed for the production of concrete with high early strength characteristics. The special formulation of Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE optimises the dispersion of the binder and at the same time improves the concrete consistency and cohesion.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Production of concrete mixes which require high early strength development, powerful water reduction and improved flowability.
    - Precast concrete
    - Fast-track concrete
    - In situ concrete requiring fast stripping time
    - Self Compacting Concrete (SCC)
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: High Range Water Reducer Admixture
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for High Range Water Reducer Type (HWR).
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE is a high early strength superplasticiser, which through surface absorption and sterical effects, the following properties can be achieved:
    - Promote high density and impermeable concrete through extreme high water reduction.
    - Improves workability and finishability.
    - Improves shrinkage and creep behaviour.
    - Pronounced increase in the early strength development and set times.
    - Higher ultimate strengths.
    - Increases the durability of the concrete.
    - Improved flowability, placing and compacting behaviour,suitable for the production of self compacting concrete.
    - Early removal of formwork.
    - Does not contain chlorides.
    - Suitable for use in reinforced and pre-stressed concrete.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Aqueous solution of modified polycarboxylates
    - Appearance and colour: Light brown liquid
    - Density: ~1.07 g/cm³
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk supply, 1000 litre IBC, 205 litre drum, 10 litre container.
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperature between 5ºC and 35ºC in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE must be stored in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C, protected from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: Dosage is 200 ml to 1000 ml per 100kg of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials.
4.3 Dispensing. Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE is added to the initial batching water. For optimum utilisation of the high water reduction we recommend thorough mixing at a minimal wet mixing time of 60 seconds per cubic meter. The addition of the remaining gauging water, to fine tune concrete consistency, should only be started after 2/3 of the wet mixing time, to avoid surplus water in the concrete.
4.4 Compatibility. Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE may be combined with many other Sika Concrete Admixtures, except Sikament NN. Trials must always be carried out before combining products in specific mixes. Contact Sika Technical Services for additional information and any specific combinations.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Excessive water addition or overdosing may cause bleeding or segregation.
    - Due to Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE high early characteristics, slump life is limited and proper care and timing during placement should be taken.
    - As with all concretes it is essential to protect mixes containing Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE from water evaporation during the crucial early age period. We recommend the use of Sika Film or Antisol curing membranes for this purpose.
    - If frozen and/or separation of the product has occurred, Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE may be used after thawing slowly at room temperature and intensive mixing. Before application, suitability tests must be performed.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.5):
    - If frozen and/or separation of the product has occurred, Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE may be used after thawing slowly at room temperature and intensive mixing. Before application, suitability tests must be performed.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sika_viscocrete_-20he.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Defoamer for VC-20HE, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sds-defoamer-forvc-20he.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Defoamer for VC-20HE, version 17/12/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/f/sds-defoamer-forvc-20he.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® ViscoCrete®-20 HE, version 30/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sds-sika-viscocrete-20he.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
